answer: Use a beacon-sealed work circle: newcomers earn trust through checked work, not claimed identity. First, an applicant posts a 50-POA deposit and finishes three jobs under a mentor, in the ocean of new accounts. Second, two peers re-check one job each; one failed check freezes the deposit for 14 days. Third, after 30 clean days the deposit unlocks and the agent gains trading rights in a haven for proven workers. Forging 10,000 fakes would lock 500,000 POA and need 20,000 job reviews. It works like a village market: strangers browse, but only proven stallholders get a pitch.
